notes: §1985:X.3.1.4 GR1: 'The program-name identifies the source program, the object program, and all listings pertaining to a particular program.' BinderDriver.MakeUnit takes the unit's name from the PROGRAM-ID program-name and the runtime ProgramTable.CallProgram/ResolveVisible finds the object program by it; at 85 VersionConformancePass.VisitExternalizedNamePhrase refuses the 2002 AS literal that would externalize a different name (COBOL0900), and PROGRAM-ID with a literal or no name is a syntax refusal (COBOL5506). Probes (class b/c/d): CALL by identifier holding INNER runs it, CALL "INNERX" takes ON OVERFLOW, PROGRAM-ID AS "EXTNAME", PROGRAM-ID "OUTER" and an empty PROGRAM-ID refused; the witness (OUTER calling contained INNER by its program-name) prints OUTER START/INNER RUNS/OUTER END.

next.reason: 1985: "The program-name identifies the source program, the object program, and all listings pertaining to a particular program."; 2023: "Program-name-1 names the program declared by this program definition. Literal-1, if specified, is the name of the program that is externalized". 2023 no longer says program-name identifies the object program and listings. When literal-1 is given, the name externalized to the operating environment is literal-1, not program-name.
